    payload = case["payload"]
    attempts = payload["attempts"]
    max_attempts = payload["max_attempts"]
    
    # Check success
    if any(att["success"] for att in attempts):
        return {
            "decision": "success_terminate",
            "next_attempt_index": -1,
            "memory_update": None
        }
    
    # Check repeated failure signature
    signatures = [att["failure_signature"] for att in attempts]
    if len(signatures) != len(set(signatures)):
        return {
            "decision": "repeated_failure_terminate",
            "next_attempt_index": -1,
            "memory_update": None
        }
    
    # Check budget
    if len(attempts) >= max_attempts:
        return {
            "decision": "budget_exhausted_terminate",
            "next_attempt_index": -1,
            "memory_update": None
        }
    
    # Otherwise, retry
    last_attempt = attempts[-1] if attempts else None
    if attempts:
        memory_update = {
            "reflection": last_attempt["reflection"],
            "failure_signature": last_attempt["failure_signature"]
        }
    else:
        memory_update = {}
    
    next_index = len(attempts)  # 0-based index for next attempt
    return {
        "decision": "retry",
        "next_attempt_index": next_index,
        "memory_update": memory_update
    }
